verdict.rationale: Dialpad is a cloud phone and contact-center platform, so an IVR or auto-attendant phone menu is an applicable axis. However, nothing in the evidence documents building a menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams. The closest items are adjacent features: assigning an operator to a queued call, AI voice agents that hand off to humans, and a vague 'design custom voice experiences' marketing line. None of these is the story's capability.
